errors.evidence: The RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit line reaches its lowest point near −6% at Layer13-20 according to the description, but the image shows it dips to approximately −6% at Layer13-20. However, looking more carefully at the image, the lowest point for the light blue line appears to be around −6%, which is roughly correct. This needs closer inspection — actually the light blue line dips to about -6% at Layer13-20, so this seems acceptable.

The reference and image show the LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit (red line) at Layer5-12 dipping to around -2% to -2.5%, while the light blue RULER4k line at Layer5-12 is around -2% to -2.5%. These values appear approximately correct but the description swaps the values for LB-Avg red line - actually looking again this seems fine.

The image shows the RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit (dark blue) line at Layer21-28 is around -11%, but the reference description and image suggest it is closer to -11% to -12%. This is approximately correct.

The reference description notes the light blue RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit line moves to around -5% to -6% at Layer13-20, not -2%. The machine description correctly identifies this for the RULER4k series but also assigns -2% to Layer13-20 for LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit. Looking at the image, the red line at Layer13-20 is around -2%, which seems approximately correct.

The reference description states the RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit (light blue) line starts around 0% at Layer1-4. The image shows this line starting around -1% to -2% at Layer1-4, not near 0%. The machine description says 'near 0% (slightly negative)' which is a reasonable approximation.
